scale: municipal point forcing, not a field
reference_note: A is the reference of the demonstration; it is the current rotation of a grower only if the grower says so.

maize.rule: day after the soy cycle (115 days)

brachiaria.rule: sown with the maize; desiccated 15 days before the next soy

long_fallow.rule: bare fallow from the soy harvest to the next soy sowing

weather.source: NASA POWER daily point (IMERG rain), retrospective

soil.basis: fixed hypothesis, not a measured profile

sources.straw_factor: assumed reduction of soil evaporation by straw

windows.agricultural_year: soy sowing to the day before the next soy sowing; identical for every strategy
windows.post_soy: day after the soy cycle to the day before the next soy sowing; identical for every strategy
windows.off_season: own off-season of each strategy; lengths differ, so it is reported but is not the comparison window

indicator_definitions.covered_days: days of the agricultural year with a crop or cover present (binary engine flag, not ground-cover percentage)
indicator_definitions.bare_days: days of the agricultural year without crop or cover
indicator_definitions.off_season_days: length of the own off-season of the strategy (differs between strategies)
indicator_definitions.off_season_water_use_mm: actual evapotranspiration in the own off-season of the strategy
indicator_definitions.off_season_drainage_mm: water leaving the bucket below the root zone in the own off-season of the strategy
indicator_definitions.storage_at_next_sowing_mm: available soil water on the day before the next soy sowing
indicator_definitions.soy_deficit_mm: crop need minus water use (ETc - ETa) in the soy cycle
indicator_definitions.soy_stress_days: soy days with water stress coefficient below 1
indicator_definitions.maize_deficit_mm: ETc - ETa in the maize cycle; null where maize is not grown
indicator_definitions.maize_stress_days: maize days with water stress coefficient below 1; null where maize is not grown
indicator_definitions.next_soy_establishment_deficit_mm: ETc - ETa in the first 15 days of the next soy; null when the next season is not simulated
indicator_definitions.year_days: days from soy sowing to the next soy sowing (same for every strategy)
indicator_definitions.year_rain_mm: rain in the agricultural year (same for every strategy)
indicator_definitions.year_water_use_mm: actual evapotranspiration in the agricultural year
indicator_definitions.year_drainage_mm: drainage below the bucket in the agricultural year; it does not measure erosion, leaching or infiltration
indicator_definitions.post_soy_days: days from the soy harvest to the next soy sowing (same for every strategy)
indicator_definitions.post_soy_water_use_mm: actual evapotranspiration from the soy harvest to the next soy sowing
indicator_definitions.post_soy_drainage_mm: drainage from the soy harvest to the next soy sowing

brachiaria.label: B
brachiaria.sequence: soy -> maize intercropped with Brachiaria -> cover until desiccation

soy_long_fallow.label: C
soy_long_fallow.sequence: soy -> bare fallow until the next soy (no maize)

comparisons_note: Paired differences by agricultural year on the common valid years. min and max are the range across the simulated years, not a calibrated predictive interval.

rain.label: sensitivity test on historical weather, not a climate forecast
rain.method: every daily rain multiplied by the factor on the same day sequence; ET0 and all other inputs unchanged; soil water carried continuously

temperature.reason: a temperature shift needs FAO-56 ET0 recomputed with a declared humidity policy; not part of this package

evidence: Simulation under stated hypotheses; no field measurement of these effects in Sorriso.
